description: Source code for Git's tracing and performance logging functionality, including trace initialization, timestamping, and repository setup tracing.

methods.name: get_trace_fd
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the trace file descriptor based on environment variable or override.

methods.name: trace_override_envvar
methods.description: Overrides the trace environment variable with a specified value and reinitializes trace settings.

methods.name: trace_disable
methods.description: Disables tracing for a given trace key, closing file descriptor if needed.

methods.name: prepare_trace_line
methods.description: Prepares a trace line with timestamp, file, and line info if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: trace_write
methods.description: Writes trace data to the trace file descriptor.

methods.name: trace_verbatim
methods.description: Outputs raw trace data if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: trace_vprintf_fl
methods.description: Formats and outputs a trace message with file and line info.

methods.name: trace_argv_vprintf_fl
methods.description: Formats and outputs a trace message with command-line arguments.

methods.name: trace_strbuf_fl
methods.description: Outputs a trace message from a strbuf.

methods.name: trace_performance_enter
methods.description: Marks the start of a performance measurement.

methods.name: trace_printf_key_fl
methods.description: Outputs a formatted trace message with a specific trace key.

methods.name: trace_argv_printf_fl
methods.description: Outputs a formatted trace message with command-line arguments.

methods.name: trace_performance_fl
methods.description: Outputs a performance trace message with timestamp.

methods.name: trace_performance_leave_fl
methods.description: Marks the end of a performance measurement.

methods.name: trace_repo_setup
methods.description: Logs repository setup details such as directories and work tree.

methods.name: trace_command_performance
methods.description: Tracks performance of a git command based on argv.
